I grew up playing Call of Duty, so making this a first-person shooter felt more like me than making a regular chart. I liked the irony: I’m looking through a scope, thinking I’m in control, while the apps I’m aiming at are already targeting my attention. On TikTok and Instagram, I pretty much watch whatever gets put in front of me. Music is different. I usually want my songs, not someone else’s picks. And with ChatGPT or Claude, I’m constantly going, “No, not that. Try again.” I’ll take the help, but I want the design to feel like mine. Making this showed me that I’m not equally protective of every decision. I’ll give away my scrolling time pretty easily, but my creative choices? Those matter. AI helped build the project; the usage times are illustrative, not measured.
